headline: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra Pioneers Rapid Hardware Design for AI Agents
summary: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra has designed a custom hardware device for the Codex coding agent in just one week, highlighting the rapid integration of AI models with physical systems. This showcases the potential for faster development cycles and more efficient AI deployment.
whyItMatters: It demonstrates the growing convergence of AI and hardware, enabling faster and more efficient development of AI-driven applications and agents.
